verdict.rationale: GitLab is itself a CI/CD platform, so headless automation is native to it. The docs describe a REST API for automating workflows and managing CI/CD processes, built on an autogenerated OpenAPI spec, and probes confirm an official CLI. Token and SSH authentication and official Docker images further support unattended, scripted operation. missing for 10: detailed docs on using the CLI non-interactively in pipelines, evidence that Duo agents/flows can be triggered headlessly from CI, independent hands-on corroboration.
